  • Iranian strike on Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia reported larger than expected; claims of damage to refuellers and an E‑3 AWACS — unconfirmed.

  • IRGC demanded US condemn alleged strikes on Iranian universities by noon and warned US campuses in the Middle East are at risk.
  • Bahrain confirms Iranian strike on an aluminum facility. UAE and Kuwait air defences intercepted incoming missiles.
  • Flight restrictions: flight scan shows 585 aircraft; airports closed in Iran, Iraq and Lebanon.
  • UAVs launched from Iraq struck Qasrak base in NW Syria. Yemen’s Houthis opened a new front.
  • Hormuz: Iran allowing passage for Russia, India, China while blocking others.
  • Diplomacy: Trump announced a second 10‑day pause on US energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request and progress in talks; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating.

Tactical notes

  • Air defences in UAE/Kuwait scored interceptions — successful mitigations of incoming missiles.
  • Reported damage to an AWACS would be tactically significant if verified. Treat that casualty report as unconfirmed.
  • 🟢 Good News: Missile interceptions and a conditional US pause on energy strikes create a limited de‑escalation window.
Threat assessment: Escalating

  • מזל"טים מעיראק תקפו בסיס קסראק בצפון‑מערב סוריה. החות'ים בתימן פתחו חזית חדשה.
  • מיצר הורמוז: איראן מאפשרת מעבר למדינות ידידותיות (רוסיה, הודו, סין) וחוסמת אחרות.
  • דיפלומטיה: טראמפ הכריז על הפסקת אש שנייה לפגיעות באנרגיה (10 ימים; תוקף עד 6.4.2026 20:00 ET), לפי בקשה איראנית לטענתו; איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן משמשת מתווכת.

הערות טקטיות

  • מערכות ההגנה אישרו יירוטים באיחוד האמירויות וכווית — הצלחות הגנתיות.
  • דיווחים על נזק ל‑AWACS יהיו בעלי משמעות טקטית גבוהה אם יאומתו. יש להתייחס כהודעה לא מאומתת.

48.en:
Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes struck Tehran, Isfahan, Khorramshahr and other Iranian sites in the last 48 hours. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas launched missile/rocket/drone strikes at Israel. Northern border active daily.
  • Pause announced: Trump announced a 10-day pause on strikes against Iranian energy (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an "Iranian Government request" and progress in talks. Iran denies direct talks. The prior 5-day pause was violated within hours.
  • Northern Border: Daily Hezbollah fire and rocket exchanges. IDF continues targeted strikes on what it calls "critical" Iranian-linked sites.
  • Gulf & Hormuz: Iran is allowing passage for vessels from Russia, India and China while restricting others. Bahrain's Alba aluminium plant was struck and set ablaze. UAE and Kuwait air defenses intercepted incoming missiles.
  • Saudi front: Reports of significant damage at Prince Sultan Air Base — multiple tankers and an E-3 AWACS reportedly affected.
  • Regional fronts: Houthis opened a new front with strikes toward Israel. UAV/drone attacks from Iraq and Syria hit bases. C-RAM systems active defending a US base in Hasakah/Qasrak.
  • US military posture: Multiple media reports the Pentagon is preparing for limited ground operations in Iran lasting days–weeks. Several regional airports remain closed (Iran, Iraq, Lebanon).
  • IRGC messaging & domestic politics: IRGC threatened US campuses and universities after alleged strikes. Reports of internal regime rifts in Tehran.
  • Diplomacy: Pakistan mediating. The US pause offers a short negotiation window, but prior violations reduce trust.
  • Logistics & markets: Fertilizer and energy supply risks rising due to strikes and facility damage.
  • 🟢 Good News: UAE and Kuwait successfully intercepted missiles. Pakistan mediation is active. The US pause creates a temporary de-escalation opportunity.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • חזית סעודית: דיווחים על נזק משמעותי בבסיס פרינס סולטן — מכליות דלק ו-Mission E-3 AWACS נפגעו ככל הנראה.
